WORK EXPERIENCE
Underdog Strategies, New York, NY — Digital Advertising and Field Manager
JULY  2024 - Present
Spearheaded a new digital ad strategy for charter school clients, including sentiment analysis of ad copy, which boosted student inquiries by 35% and lowered cost per lead by 15% across key campaigns.
Collaborated with in-house graphic designers and/or working with freelance photographers, videographers, and other creatives.
Managed and optimized social media campaigns, leading to a 50% increase in brand awareness and a 25% increase in engagement with key demographics in the Bronx.
Led and trained a team of 15+ canvassers, exceeding monthly lead generation targets by an average of 10% through a new data-informed training program focused on effective community engagement.
Streamlined lead data review and updated real-time dashboards for executive leadership, developing metrics for canvasser productivity and providing immediate insights for campaign adjustments
Behavioral Associates, New York, NY — Operations Manager
JUNE 2023 - JULY  2024
Strategically directed the software development and implementation of a private use digital medical records, billing, and appointment management system.
Created and delivered both in-person and virtual educational programming and training for clients, new hires, trainees, and graduate interns.
Coordinated a referral network with local hospitals and private practices, and worked with local private schools to bring mental health initiatives and town hall discussions to their institution.
Acceleration Strategies, Brooklyn, NY — Campaign Manager
JUNE 2020 - JUNE  2023
Managed a portfolio of over 500 actual and prospective political donors, cultivated relationships with donors which helped to secure over $30,000 in financial contributions from individuals and organizations, leading to three primary wins
Expanded local press coverage with a $10,000 ad campaign, generating large volumes of volunteer signups and donations; managed social media platforms and drafted press releases
Oversaw field operations including volunteer coordination, an intern program, community outreach reaching 37,000 voters, and managing campaign budgets of  over $190,000
Reached out on behalf of the campaign to successfully convert community leaders, political organizations labor unions and small business owners to supporters
Set goals and tasks for campaign staff in all departments and monitored campaign staff progress on tasks through daily debriefs and trackers
Bloomberg 2020 Campaign, New York, NY — Regional Organizing Director
NOVEMBER 2019 - JUNE 2020
Recruited and managed a staff of 20 paid organizers and volunteers
Leveraged CRM software to identify likely supporters and execute voter outreach
Met regularly  with important community leaders and coalition partners
Political Campaign Work, New York, NY —  Deputy Campaign Manager
JANUARY 2018 - OCTOBER 2019
Co-ordinated districtwide GOTV operations to maximize voter turnout and conversion.
Collect data on political districts, candidates, and issues to provide actionable insights
Interfaced with clients, collected specifications for the campaign plan and realized the plan by building suitable campaign team and infrastructure
The Common Good, New York, NY —  Project Manager
AUGUST 2015 - DECEMBER 2017
Planned and ran politically themed events, culminating in a yearly forum for influential attendees, featuring political, military and journalistic thought-leaders
Oversaw a team of seven in the production of original branded video content and white papers
Analyzed social media and email messaging metrics to  improve SEO
Creative Associates International, Washington, DC — Data Analyst
JUNE 2014 - AUGUST 2014
Captured and cleaned data from congressional budget justification PDFs to create a datafile for original data analysis in Excel to identify potential future market trends
Produced a report to inform resource allocation for millions of dollars in contracts for FY 2014-2015 firm Requests For Proposals
Presented that report to a meeting of the heads of departments and answered questions to explain key insights
EDUCATION
University of California, Davis 								Bachelor of Arts in Political Science					Class of 2015
KEY SKILLS
Operations, Project Management, CRM, Data Analysis, MS Excel, MS Powerpoint,  MS Project, Asana, Meta Ads Manager, Programmatic Display, Google Adwords, Youtube, TikTok, Native Advertising, WordPress, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SEO, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe InDesign, Adobe Photoshop
